title: Gerente de infraestrutura de TI
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Gerente de Projetos (Infraestrutura, Banco de Dados e Cibersegurança)


Buscamos um Gerente de Infraestrutura para atuar na gestão de iniciativas estratégicas envolvendo banco de dados, infraestrutura e cibersegurança.

Será responsável por planejar, coordenar e acompanhar todas as etapas dos projetos, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade dentro de prazos e orçamentos definidos.

Ter experiência comprovada em projetos de migração ou implantação de sistemas e implementação de processos baseados no ITIL.

Perfil desejado:

Profissional com visão técnica e estratégica, forte capacidade de gestão, comunicação clara e habilidade em coordenar equipes multidisciplinares.

Forte conhecimento em processos ITIL (se tiver experiência com implementação do ITIL será diferencial)

Formação - nível superior

Desejável - Certificação ITIL


Atuação: 100% Remota


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

#VemPraSIS #SomosSIS

title: Recruiting Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Recruitment Manager to join our Recruiting Team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. This person must be proactive, detail-oriented, and demonstrate excellent analytical abilities, as well as teamwork and multitasking skills. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry! to accompany our strategic growth objectives in hiring personnel and key roles.


Key responsibilities:


- Collaborate in the definition and execution of the talent attraction strategy.

- Plan alternative scenarios of recruitment according to business needs.

- Design and validate best practices for the attraction, search, and selection of professionals for our vacancies in collaboration with leaders and Managers.

- Provide new ideas and solutions aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the selection processes, methods, and technology.

- Preparation of reports and metrics.


Requirements:


- At least 5 years of experience as a recruiter.

- Experience in leading teams of at least 5 people.

- Good interpersonal relationships.

- Knowledge of the IT market, both of development professionals and business profiles.

- Good command of English to get by on a day-to-day basis.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Python Developer Pleno
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Python Developer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter web crawlers e scrapers
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de produto, design e operações para definir requisitos e entregar soluções eficazes;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com Python 3;
  • Conhecimentos protocolos web, como HTTP/HTTPS;
  • Experiência prática com scraping e crawling (ex: requests, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Conhecimento de cloud AWS.
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Prática em Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Clean Architecture;
  • Conhecimento de Redes de computadores;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de CI/CD utilizando github actions;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga!

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.

title: Windfarm Controller Commissioner
description:
Job description:

  • Global commissioning of Nordex groups wind farm controller (CWE & SGCS), mostly remote
  • Area of responsibility: commissioning of wind farm controller, controller interfaces and preparation of grid code testing
  • Regular contact and communication to the clients' experts to elaborate project-specific requirements, testing and solutions
  • Gain experiences of running and closing windfarm controller projects
  • Support of negotiations with customers, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Testing and improving processes within the Windfarm Control Operations department together with the department leads

As Windfarm Controller Commissioner, you will report directly to the group lead Windfarm Control Commissioning as disciplinary superior within Global PM/EPC – Windfarm Control Operations.

Job requirements:

  • University degree in Electrical Engineering, Technology, Electronics, IT, telecommunications or other equivalent technical education
  • Broad knowledge of wind farm controller tools and processes
  • Hardwired
  • Modbus TCP
  • IEC 60870-5-101
  • IEC 60870-5-104
  • OPC UA
  • DNP3
  • Grid operator interfaces and customer interfaces like:
  • Root cause analyses tools like wire shark
  • PLC commissioning
  • Grid Code Testing
  • PCMS - Parameter Configuration and Management System
  • Certificate to act as electrically skilled person is valuable
  • Knowledge about wind turbine technologies is beneficial
  • Self-responsible, structured and solution-oriented working
  • Very good communication skills, strong planning- and organizational skills
  • Fluency in English. Spanish and other languages are an added value
  • Intercultural understanding, ability to work productively in multitask teams and team player attitude
  • Willingness to go on business trips


The manufacture of wind farms in the onshore segment has been our main competence and passion for over 35 years. With more than 28 GW of installed capacity worldwide, our turbines provide sustainable energy to more than 80% of the global energy market and we are one of the largest companies in the wind sector. We are present in more than 25 markets and have production facilities in Germany, Spain, Brazil, USA, Mexico and India offering our more than 6,500 employees the opportunity for international and intercultural cooperation. We are growing and driving together the expansion of renewable energies around the world. If you wish, you can be part of our team. If you are passionate about renewable energies, you love working as a team and share our values of integrity, companionship, respect and entrepreneurship. We would like you to be part of it!

title: Supply Chain Manager - Food Manufacturing
description:
Please note: This role requires the successful candidate to relocate to Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu


Forney Enterprises is a leading kava manufacturing and export company with deep agribusiness roots, partnering directly with local farmers in the purchase of raw materials and contributing to the sustainable development of Vanuatu’s kava industry. As part of our long-term commitment to sustainability, community partnerships, and operational excellence, we are establishing a dedicated Supply Chain function within our business to strengthen this critical area and ensure the future of the industry.


The Role:

As Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring a consistent and sustainable supply of raw materials—particularly kava—while driving efficiency across procurement, warehousing, and logistics. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on agricultural expertise . You’ll build strong partnerships with farmers, oversee compliance with food safety and sustainability standards, and guide your team to deliver reliable supply chain performance.


While the primary focus is on strengthening supply chain systems and farmer engagement, there may also be opportunities to explore partnerships and international initiatives that further strengthen Vanuatu’s kava industry and contribute to its long-term sustainability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement supply chain strategies that align with company goals and sustainability initiatives.
  • Oversee raw material procurement, focusing on kava sourcing, quality control, and supplier relationships.
  • Conduct farm visits to assess soil quality, cultivation practices, and compliance with sourcing standards.
  • Lead farmer engagement through roundtable meetings, promoting best practices and sustainable methods.
  • Manage warehouse operations, ensuring accurate inventory management, storage, and dispatch.
  • Provide leadership to Procurement Field Officers and Warehouse Supervisor.
  • Collaborate with QA, Finance, HR, and Logistics teams to achieve business targets.
  • Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies across procurement and logistics.
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, analysis, and process optimisation.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, GMP, and SQF certification standards.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Agriculture, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in supply chain, procurement, or agricultural sourcing (food or agribusiness preferred).
  • Knowledge of kava farming practices, soil quality, and agricultural supply chains (highly desirable).
  • Strong background in supplier engagement, contract management, and risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted farmer and supplier partnerships.
  • Demonstrated commitment to sustainability and rural development initiatives.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a growing business with international reach.
  • Contribute to the sustainable development of Vanuatu’s Kava Industry.
  • Lead a diverse team and make a lasting impact on both company operations and local farming communities.
  • Competitive remuneration package offered, with relocation support available for the right candidate.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
The Company

A well-established tech organization building advanced AI products for healthcare and clinical research. The team focuses on secure, reliable platforms that process sensitive medical data and support research and clinical workflows.


Role & Responsibilities

As a Senior SRE , you will:

  • Design and automate infrastructure (infrastructure-as-code tools)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and release automation
  • Operate and scale production systems on major cloud platforms
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices
  • Enforce security and compliance controls for protected health data
  • Create and test disaster recovery and continuity plans
  • Produce clear operational documentation and runbooks
  • Coach and guide more junior engineers and on-call teams
  • Work closely with engineering and research teams to enable fast, safe delivery of product features


Job Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in an SRE / Infrastructure / Platform role
  • Hands-on with IaC (Terraform or equivalent)
  • Production experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Solid scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python )
  • Proven work with CI/CD systems and pipelines
  • Experience running workloads on cloud providers (GCP, Azure, or AWS)
  • Familiar with observability tools (metrics, logs, tracing)
  • Practical knowledge of security best practices and data-protection tooling
  • Strong communication, troubleshooting, and incident response skills


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with healthcare compliance (HIPAA, SOC 2)
  • Background in high-performance or data-intensive environments
  • Prior mentorship or technical leadership experience
  • Deep experience scaling Terraform + Kubernetes at production scale

description:
POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO

A Onze é uma das nossas start-ups e está reinventando a Previdência Privada. Somos a primeira PrevTech do Brasil, trazendo uma proposta totalmente digital para um mercado tradicionalmente analógico. Acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação podem ter impacto real na maneira com que as pessoas se preparam financeiramente para o futuro. Além de uma empresa de tecnologia, somos também uma gestora de investimentos, com fundos de previdência privada eficientes e desenhados para trazer o melhor retorno com o menor custo possível – como a Previdência deve ser. Nossos fundos, plataforma tecnológica e soluções de saúde financeira tem como objetivo maximizar a acumulação eficiente de patrimônio, um dos maiores desafios do povo Brasileiro.


O TIME

O time da Onze é distribuído em pequenos times ágeis que valorizam a cultura onde cada pessoa desenvolvedora tem autonomia para participar de todo o processo de desenvolvimento, inclusive as etapas de concepção de ideias. Priorizamos e incentivamos que as pessoas se desenvolvam tanto tecnicamente como em outras áreas de competência como comunicação e liderança. Temos orgulho de trabalhar na primeira fintech em previdência privada do Brasil e temos a inovação tecnológica e criatividade como uma das bases do nosso dia a dia.


A OPORTUNIDADE

Você irá participar diretamente das etapas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes automatizados, code review e deploy de funcionalidades em sistemas na nuvem. Você vai trabalhar com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta em aplicações que demandam alta disponibilidade, baixa latência e escalabilidade em um ambiente de desenvolvimento que prioriza eficiência, testes, qualidade e alta entrega de valor.


O QUE PROCURAMOS

  • Pessoas das áreas de Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas que sejam proativas e apaixonadas por tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação. Ex: Go, Java, Python, C# (gostamos bastante de Go, se não souber, você pode aprender aqui!);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc);
  • Experiência em computação em nuvem (de preferência AWS);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de solução;
  • Valorizar qualidade e código limpo;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados;
  • Interesse em desenvolver soft skills como comunicação e liderança;
  • Inglês intermediário/Avançado


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Acompanhamento e gestão de carreira com ciclos de avaliação semestrais estruturados e feedbacks recorrentes;
  • Planos de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde para Pet;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Plano de saúde financeira incluindo consultorias individualizadas com profissionais certificados;

  • Incentivo educacional anual em formato de reembolso;

  • Bônus anual de acordo com a performance;
  • Voucher ifood no mês de aniversário;

title: Trilingual Technical Support Analyst
description:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.


To support our continuous growth we are looking for a Trilingual Technical Support Analyst to join our team.


Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!


We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.

title: Desenvolvedor Python Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e evoluir aplicações em Python com foco em IA Generativa , incluindo pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) . Também irá integrar e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Bedrock , além de implementar e gerenciar comunicação via MCP para integração com modelos de IA. Outra atribuição importante será a participação ativa em code reviews , definição de padrões técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python .
  • Conhecimento em IA Generativa (GenAI) , especialmente em LLMs .
  • Vivência com AWS (desejável foco em AWS Bedrock ).
  • Experiência em arquitetura e implementação de RAG .

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

Ruby on Rails or any other ODD language or framework

Computer science degree

Senior - 5y as a minimum.

A solid candidate could be 2 or 3y with experience with Ruby on Rails in operational tasks

PostgreSQL

Kafka

Event Sourcing,

QA experience - quality assurance by the developers.

Fullstack (70% back + 30% front)

US - Atlantic time zone - PST or EST. But a manageable start right away

Interview process: AM screening / Panel - full interview - 3 parts (culture, coding exercise, software design exercise) / AM Final interview.

Communication, verbal and written - excellent. (English)


Responsibilities:

Skills/Experience:

- 3-5+ years of software engineering experience

- Strong communication skills

- Understanding of reusable components/building component libraries - Understanding of building production-ready web applications and systems

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, JavaScript, NextJS , or another programming language - Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools - Bachelor of Computer Science degree or equivalent experience

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior UX Writer
description:
Como UX Writer na área de ERP Soluções, você terá um papel estratégico na evolução da prática de conteúdo dentro da Sankhya, atuando em parceria com designers, tech writers e product managers.


Sua missão será estruturar e escalar processos de escrita em interfaces complexas (como ERPs), contribuindo diretamente para a redução de fricções, a melhoria da experiência do usuário e a otimização de resultados de negócio.


Se você tem experiência com UX Writing em softwares de gestão ou sistemas digitais robustos e deseja apoiar a construção de uma disciplina de conteúdo orientada a métricas e resultados, essa vaga é para você!



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Criar, revisar e evoluir conteúdos de interface dos produtos Sankhya, garantindo clareza, consistência e aderência ao Design System e Content System .


  • Atuar na implementação e manutenção de processos de Content Ops , incluindo métricas, indicadores e fluxos de governança.


  • Conduzir iniciativas de padronização e revisão do legado textual em sistemas ERP.


  • Aplicar boas práticas de UX Writing para interfaces complexas, orientando times de produto sobre microcopy, fluxos de erro, onboarding, mensagens de sistema, notificações e tutoriais em produto.


  • Utilizar Figma para criação, iteração e documentação de componentes de conteúdo junto com designers.


  • Colaborar com tech writers, designers e engenheiros para integrar a estratégia de conteúdo em diferentes pontos da jornada do usuário.


  • Acompanhar métricas de experiência (ex.: NPS, CSAT, deflection de tickets, engajamento em produto) para validar o impacto das soluções de conteúdo.


  • Conduzir workshops e dinâmicas de alinhamento para difundir boas práticas de conteúdo em toda a empresa.




REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Graduação em Letras, Design, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como UX Writer, preferencialmente em sistemas ERP, SaaS ou plataformas de software complexas.


  • Conhecimento em Content Ops , incluindo métricas, governança e processos de escalabilidade de conteúdo.


  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipação como Figma .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) para Android Pl/Sr
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Estamos à procura de um desenvolvedor Android responsável pelo desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e manutenção de módulos já existentes. O foco inicial será o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades com integração de serviços backend em REST. O trabalho será em conjunto com outros desenvolvedores trabalhando em diferentes camadas da aplicação com o intuito de gerarmos sinergia e qualidade no desenvolvimento.


Habilidades e Requisitos


  • Experiência em participar de times atuando com métodos ágeis;
  • Linguagem Java / Kotlin;
  • Gradle;
  • SOLID;
  • Desing Patterns (MVVM / Clean Architecture);
  • Testes unitários;
  • GIT (Gitflow, Git Lab).


Formato de trabalho


Remoto.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Tibco Developer
description:
Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 5 years of experience with TIBCO BusinessWorks 5 and 6.
  • Strong knowledge of TIBCO BusinessWorks Container Edition (CE).
  • Experience with RESTful integrations and service-oriented architecture (SOA).
  • Strong command of XML, XSD, XPATH, and JDBC.
  • Experience integrating with AWS API Gateway.
  • Ability to analyze, design, and implement complex integration architectures.
  • Experience in migration or modernization projects for integration buses.
  • Previous participation in integration projects within large-scale corporate environments.
  • Fluent in Portuguese (B2+) – Mandatory .


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: remote from Brazil;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Hartmann Young is proud to be partnered with a leading dietary supplement manufacturer serving both domestic and international markets across South America. The company is recognised for its strong scientific foundation, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and commitment to innovation in nutritional products. With a diversified customer base spanning consumer health, functional foods, and nutraceutical brands, the business is poised for a new phase of strategic growth and international expansion.


As Chief Executive Officer , you will lead the company’s strategic, operational, and commercial direction across South America. You will be responsible for driving profitability, operational excellence, and long-term growth, ensuring the business continues to innovate and compete at the forefront of the dietary supplement manufacturing industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company’s strategic vision and long-term business objectives across Brazil, Chile, Argentina, and other key South American markets.
  • Oversee all business operations, including manufacturing, R&D, sales, quality, and regulatory functions.
  • Lead organisational transformation to enhance efficiency, scalability, and market responsiveness.
  • Drive revenue growth through new partnerships, customer acquisition, and product innovation.
  • Ensure operational excellence, quality assurance, and compliance with international standards (GMP, ISO, ANVISA, etc.).
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all departments.
  • Represent the company in strategic alliances, investor relations, and regional industry events.
  • Work closely with the board and investors to deliver sustainable financial and market performance.


Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred).
  • 15+ years of leadership experience in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, or pharmaceutical manufacturing .
  • Proven track record in executive management, business transformation, or scaling operations across Latin America.
  • Deep understanding of supplement manufacturing processes, regulatory frameworks, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with experience leading P&L responsibility.
  • Bilingual or multilingual (Portuguese, Spanish, and English proficiency highly desirable).
  • Dynamic leadership style with a focus on innovation, growth, and organizational excellence.

title: Senior Full-stack Developer IV
description:
As a full-stack software engineer IV, you will get the opportunity to work on InComm Product Control (IPC) team. In this role, you will focus on creating, enhancing, and redesigning the applications with the most cutting-edge technologies to provide POS-integrated platform, automated decision-making at POR terminals and business intelligence analytic tools. IPC is a specialized division of InComm that provides product lifecycle tracking and returns management solutions for retailers and manufacturers.


100% Remote + CLT + Benefits (Health Insurance Coverage, Meal Vouchers, Annual Bonuses, and more!)


Responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust applications using Java and the Spring framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data) and front-end framework like Vue JS.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, QA engineers, and product managers, to analyze issues, define requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Creating and performing unit, integration, and system testing to ensure application quality and performance.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in existing applications.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the Spring ecosystem and JavaScipt communities.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Making technical and team decisions and assuming responsibility for those decisions while keeping management informed
  • Providing direction, motivating, and supporting a small group of individuals to achieve specific goals.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 8+ years of proven experience in developing Java applications (1.8 and above), specifically with the Spring framework and Spring Boot in enterprise level scalable, distributed and fault tolerant environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases including SQL, stored procedures, and data modeling with MS SQL and/or Oracle.
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and Core JavaScript. Proficiency in at least one of modern front-end frameworks like Angular, React, and/or Vue.
  • Strong understanding of object relational mapping APIs like Hibernate, JPA and/or myBatis.
  • Practical understanding of developing Restful Microservices Services using Spring boot.
  • Proficient in version control, build management, and issue tracking software (i.e. git, Maven, JIRA)
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and/or Windows server.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containerization technologies and continuous delivery tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins Pipeline, Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD and/or Snyk) is preferred.
  • Experience with SQL Sentry Tool, Dynatrace and/or Splunk is beneficial.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - C#


Principais Atividades:


Analisar tickets, de alta complexidade, de bugs e melhorias, recebidos através de sistema interno, avaliando os impactos e estimando o tempo de desenvolvimento, afim de detalhar a necessidade para a equipe de desenvolvimento;Entender a necessidade junto ao requisitante, e abrir o ticket no sistema interno, quando necessário; Desenvolver sistemas e aplicações de alta complexidade, na linguagem utilizada pela empresa, adequando-os às necessidades da área e dos clientes;Validar a solução proposta e código desenvolvido pela equipe de acordo com a descrição do ticket. Realizar commit de acordo com a especificação do mesmo;

Efetuar a publicação de sistemas e atualização de banco de dados no ambiente de produção;

Descrever o processo e fluxos do desenvolvimento, como forma de orientação a equipe, facilitando assim o entendimento; Acompanhar o desenvolvimento das demandas e esclarecer dúvidas da equipe, de acordo com a necessidade; Elaborar material de treinamento técnico e de produto para a equipe e ministrar os mesmos, de acordo com a necessidade; Avaliar ferramentas de fornecedores terceiros, quando necessário, a fim de verificar a compatibilidade com o sistema;

Líder de squad- Responder quantos aos pontos críticos e risco de atraso do pacote em tempo hábil para mitigação do problema antes do vencimento do prazo da entrega, bem como entender as dificuldades técnicas e necessidades do time no pacote e propor melhorias e plano de ação.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior.
  • Sólida experiência Linguagens/frameworks C#, ASP Net, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Angular.
  • Experiência anterior em funções de liderança, como Líder de Squad, é altamente desejável.
  • Profundo conhecimento em programação e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Habilidade de adaptação rápida a diferentes contextos;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas.



Benefícios:


Plano de Saúde Bradesco para colaborador e dependentes (cônjuge e filhos) cobertura nacional.

Assistência Odontológica

Pluxee no valor de R$ 42,00/dia

Day off + presente personalizado de aniversário

Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (equivalente a um salário do colaborador)

Horário: 40 horas semanais

Regime de contratação: CLT (Efetivo)

Salário: À combinar


OBS: Para candidatos que residem em BH e região, o modelo de trabalho é híbrido

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - C#


Principais Atividades:


Analisar tickets, de alta complexidade, de bugs e melhorias, recebidos através de sistema interno, avaliando os impactos e estimando o tempo de desenvolvimento, afim de detalhar a necessidade para a equipe de desenvolvimento;Entender a necessidade junto ao requisitante, e abrir o ticket no sistema interno, quando necessário; Desenvolver sistemas e aplicações de alta complexidade, na linguagem utilizada pela empresa, adequando-os às necessidades da área e dos clientes;Validar a solução proposta e código desenvolvido pela equipe de acordo com a descrição do ticket. Realizar commit de acordo com a especificação do mesmo;

Efetuar a publicação de sistemas e atualização de banco de dados no ambiente de produção;

Descrever o processo e fluxos do desenvolvimento, como forma de orientação a equipe, facilitando assim o entendimento; Acompanhar o desenvolvimento das demandas e esclarecer dúvidas da equipe, de acordo com a necessidade; Elaborar material de treinamento técnico e de produto para a equipe e ministrar os mesmos, de acordo com a necessidade; Avaliar ferramentas de fornecedores terceiros, quando necessário, a fim de verificar a compatibilidade com o sistema;

Líder de squad- Responder quantos aos pontos críticos e risco de atraso do pacote em tempo hábil para mitigação do problema antes do vencimento do prazo da entrega, bem como entender as dificuldades técnicas e necessidades do time no pacote e propor melhorias e plano de ação.

Plano de Saúde Bradesco para colaborador e dependentes (cônjuge e filhos) cobertura nacional.

Day off + presente personalizado de aniversário

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Backend Ops & Integrations Assistant
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

We’re seeking experienced, detail-oriented backend ops & integrations assistants to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog, but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re an effective problem-solver who’s always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re great at time management.
  • You’re a team player.
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DnD, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of professional experience in backend web development
  • Proficiency in WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, and Shopify
  • Strong PHP skills
  • Impressive portfolio
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking)
  • A bachelor’s degree (a plus)
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript
  • Expertise in responsive design and mobile-first approach
  • Able to optimize applications for maximum speed
  • Knowledge of HTML layout for the construction of email signatures and newsletters


About the Role


Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting backend work on Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify
  • Managing integrations across HubSpot, Teamwork, Google Workspace, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress
  • Handling CMS updates, plugins, and troubleshooting
  • Configuring workflows and light automation (Zapier/Make)
  • Launching websites on Webflow, WordPress, or Shopify, including domain setup, DNS/SSL, CMS updates, and go-live QA


Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Description

We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Data Engineer to lead and guide the technical evolution of our enterprise data lake. This role will combine hands-on development, tactical guidance, team leadership, and partner engagement across our technical team.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient



Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation of scalable Lakehouse architecture using Delta and medallion architecture
  • Elevate data engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
  • Lead development of scalable data pipelines using incremental ingestion and streaming
  • Build and maintain data infrastructure with tools like Databricks, Spark, Airflow 2 in an AWS environment
  • Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help us transform complex data into actionable insights
  • Ensure high data quality standards by leveraging best practice approaches
  • Help architect storage layers, metastore/catalog solutions, and performance optimization
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure in AWS using Terraform, with a deep understanding of services like S3, IAM, KMS, Glue, Athena, Redshift, SNS/SQS, MSK, and Kinesis.
  • Help guide the integration of master data management and governance solutions like Datahub to track the health, lineage, and meaning of data across the enterprise
  • Help establish team coding standards and best practices.
  • Help refine development and operational processes to drive consistent, predictable quality
  • Participate in our on-call schedule to help us ensure availability of critical data services
  • Provide technical leadership on DevOps, security, and deployment strategies for AI/ML models



Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, including senior/lead experience
  • Expertise in Lakehouse architectures, Delta/Parquet file formats, hive metastore solutions (Glue, Unity Catalog), and ETL processes (Airflow and Databricks)
  • Strong Experience with Python and SQL
  • Strong proficiency in data modeling (OLTP/OLAP)
  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure services
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) using Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Databricks experience
  • Strong AWS experience. Certified AWS Solutions Architect or Data Engineer preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or similar fields, or equivalent experience

  • Strong proficiency in data modeling (OLTP/OLAP)
  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure services
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) using Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Databricks experience
  • Strong AWS experience. Certified AWS Solutions Architect or Data Engineer preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or similar fields, or equivalent experience

title: Líder Técnico Machine Learning III
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de Machine Learning, no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir a estratégia técnica do projeto, desenvolver e comunicando uma visão clara e estratégica para a aplicação de Machine Learning, Inteligência Artificial e Data Science na Instituição;
  • Orientar desenvolvimento de Modelos Avançados, supervisionando a equipe na criação de modelos estatísticos e de aprendizado de máquina utilizando técnicas avançadas e modernas;
  • Aplicar e conceber arquitetura de soluções inovadoras para plataformas Network as a Service (NaaS) com foco em integração de técnicas de IA e ML;
  • Realizar estudos aprofundados e análises de estruturas, dados, plataformas e ferramentas de IA/ML, fornecendo insights valiosos para tomada de decisões;
  • Preparar documentações estratégica e técnica abrangente sobre as soluções propostas e adotadas, garantindo a compreensão e rastreabilidade dos projetos;
  • Liderar o Time de QA, provendo orientação e suporte ao time de Garantia da Qualidade para garantir a confiabilidade e robustez das soluções implementadas;
  • Executar revisão técnica proativa, examinar o código desenvolvido e assegurar que ele esteja em conformidade com as melhores práticas da tecnologia e promovendo a melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como Multiplicador de Conhecimento, oferecendo suporte técnico e mentorship aos colegas, promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações


Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiência em:

  • Linguagem de programação Python ou Go,
  • Métodos estatísticos para análise de dados,
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning,
  • Arquitetura em microserviços,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas,
  • Banco de dados de alto volume (relacional, não relacional, data lake ou data warehouse);


Conhecimentos em:

  • Conhecimento em Keras, PyTorch e TensorFlow,
  • MLOps,
  • Plataformas Cloud (AWS ou Azure),
  • CI/CD,
  • Melhores práticas de desenvolvimento,
  • Metodologias ágeis.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em soluções SDN;
  • Prática em projetos com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimentos em: Big Data, Data Science, gRPC, banco de dados temporal e mock de dados;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e escrita e intermediário para conversação.


Informações adicionais

Horário das atividades: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local das atividades: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho "home office".

title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Thai linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


  • Job Title: French Linguistics Expert AI Training & Content Writing.
  • Location : France
  • Required Working hours : -5 to 8 Hours\Day
  • project start Date :- 24 September 2025 ( Tentative)
  • Urgent Requirement : complete the LLM Assessment by Today.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behaviour, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Mandatory Assessments


1- LLM Assessment :- Link has been attached below for the assessment.




LLM Evaluation Assessment Guidelines:

  • No. of Questions: 122
  • No. of Sections: 7
  • Test Duration: 120 minutes (2 hours)
  • Total Marks: 122
  • Passing Criteria: High (Get at least 100+ questions correct to get passed)
  • Required: Complete by Today
  • Note: Assessment gets auto submitted after 120 minutes, maintain speed with accuracy.



2- Once you have successfully completed the LLM assessment, you will be required to take an additional assessment, the Versant test, which is designed to evaluate your English proficiency. Kindly note that achieving a score of C1 or above in this test will be mandatory.

title: Desenvolvedor Flutter - Remoto
description:
Na Arauc, desenvolvemos os mais diversos tipos de software, desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até soluções com inteligência artificial, análise de dados, automações, integrações em nuvem e IoT.


Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, atendendo, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Flutter para integrar nosso time e participar de projetos desafiadores e variados. Buscamos pessoas proativas, curiosas e apaixonadas por programação, que queiram crescer junto com a gente e deixar sua marca em produtos usados por milhares de pessoas.



Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicativos multiplataforma (Android, iOS e Web) utilizando Flutter.
  • Participar ativamente das decisões de arquitetura, design e experiência do usuário.
  • Integrar e desenvolver APIs.
  • Gerenciar comunicação entre front e back-end.
  • Colaborar com o time no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter o código limpo, testável e bem documentado.
  • Contribuir com ideias e sugestões técnicas durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento.



Desejável

  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos na App Store e Google Play.
  • Conhecimento em back-end (Node.js, Python, ou similares).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados.
  • Noções de cloud computing.
  • Interesse por UI/UX e boas práticas de design.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Apllos é uma parceira para a evolução digital da gestão da Cadeia de Valor. Soluciona com qualidade problemas complexos de diversos setores com um time de especialistas de alto nível técnico e experiência, comprometidos em resolver as demandas, por meio de relacionamentos de confiança, diretos e flexíveis, sempre sob o prisma da inovação e da visão de futuro. Desde 2015, a Apllos Solutions contribui para a melhoria da performance das empresas com serviços, produtos e conhecimentos relacionados à inovação da Cadeia de Valor.


Somos Great Place to Work! Pela 5a vez conquistamos o selo de Excelente lugar para trabalhar!


Vaga: Engenheiro de Dados


Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com sólida experiência em ingestão e transformação de dados para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e grande volume. O(a) profissional participará do desenho e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, qualidade e segurança em ambientes modernos de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de ingestão de dados em grande escala.
  • Desenvolver processos de ETL/ELT utilizando diferentes ferramentas (Spark, Athena, SQL, NoSQL).
  • Criar e manter APIs RESTful (ex.: Flask) para disponibilização de dados.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de ciência de dados e engenharia de software para integrar soluções de dados.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Databricks ou Azure Fabric (um dos dois é suficiente, ambos são diferencial).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em ingestão de dados e arquitetura de dados.
  • Desenvolvimento de ETL/ELT com Spark, Athena, SQL e NoSQL.
  • Experiência em AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Desenvolvimento em Python (scripts, bibliotecas e boas práticas).
  • Conhecimento em fluxos CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou similares).
  • Desenvolvimento de API RESTful com frameworks como Flask ou FastAPI.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DataOps e observabilidade de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes de Big Data em múltiplas nuvens.

description:
Accountant

Remote - Full Time


Join Trivium Group - Our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and a Clutch Award-winning agency


At Trivium Group, we’re more than just a full-service Amazon agency—we’re a powerhouse of passionate experts helping brands scale profitably on Amazon. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, providing top-tier strategic growth solutions without the hefty price tag. Our company thrives on strong systems, sharp people, and solid values—and now, we’re looking for an exceptional Accountant (Remote) to join our team!

Why Join Us?

✅ Competitive Salary $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month

✅ Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

✅ Semi-Flexible Hours Core hours: 09:00 - 14:00 (Eastern Standard Time), with flexibility for the remaining 3 hours

Your Role

As an Accountant at Trivium Group, you will play a crucial role in managing financial data, ensuring compliance, and optimizing financial processes. Your expertise will drive accuracy, efficiency, and financial health for our business.


Key Responsibilities

Reporting to the Head of Finance

Maintain and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Oversee accounts payable, receivable, and payroll (60+ employees)

Verify and record financial transactions in the correct accounts

Prepare monthly financial reports and adjustments

Monitor and report budget variances

Full-time (40 hours/week)

title: Senior React Engineer
description:
Sr Front End Engineer #2487


Position Summary:


Our partner, a leading SaaS provider of unified IT operations solutions, is seeking a Senior Front-End Engineer to join their team. As a Senior Engineer, you will bring technical expertise to the end-to-end design and development of innovative products and applications. We’re looking for a motivated, passionate engineer with strong experience in React and modern front-end technologies to join the team. Your contributions will be pivotal in shaping our digital products, with a focus on UI/UX design principles, user experience, and best software engineering practices. This role presents a fantastic opportunity to innovate and drive change, with the chance to directly impact products used by diverse, global customers.


Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in front-end enterprise software development, with a strong emphasis on JavaScript, CSS and React.
  • Proven track record of component-based user interface development experience, including how to construct and deconstruct components to create composable and reusable UI Elements.
  • Solid experience with accessibility, internationalization, adaptive UI, responsive design, and other core UX considerations.


Technology Skills and Strengths:


  • React
  • TypeScript/JavaScript
  • CSS
  • Design System Software (Figma, Storybook, and others)
  • UI/UX Core Design Principles
  • AWS or other major cloud platforms
  • Test-Driven Development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, and others)
  • Advanced Architecture Principles (DDD, event-driven systems)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Performance Optimization (profiling, load balancing, refactoring)
  • Cloud Architecture & Scalability best practices
  • GIT Source Control


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Architect, build, and maintain complex front-end applications using React and TypeScript, ensuring scalable, maintainable, and high-performance solutions.
  • Own the full lifecycle of features from technical scoping and UX collaboration, through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Design and implement reusable component libraries, UI patterns, and internal design systems that can be shared across teams and projects.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and back-end engineers to shape user-facing features, influence API design, and deliver polished, intuitive user experiences.
  • Drive application performance improvements by proactively profiling, identifying bottlenecks, optimizing rendering patterns, and improving load times.
  • Implement modern testing strategies unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress to ensure product reliability and prevent regressions.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are built into every component and page, delivering inclusive experiences across a diverse range of users and devices.
  • Handle front-end deployments via modern CI/CD pipelines, managing build optimizations, preview environments, and release tracking.
  • Uphold high coding standards through thoughtful code reviews, constructive feedback, and occasional mentorship of mid-level and junior engineers.
  • Continuously advocate for front-end quality, scalability, security, and best practices, helping shape architectural decisions and team engineering culture.
  • Stay current with evolving front-end technologies and frameworks (React 18+, Next.js, modern state management), and bring forward ideas to keep products modern, performant, and developer friendly.
